comparisons.name: text-edit-light
comparisons.description: The ruler of a TextEdit document window, full width: rule, ticks, numbers, the indent markers at 0, five left tab stops and the tail indent, Aqua. Whole crop: the numbers are set in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: text-edit-drawing-light
comparisons.description: The ruler of a TextEdit document window, full width: rule, ticks, numbers, the indent markers at 0, five left tab stops and the tail indent, Aqua. The same crop with the nine numbers masked: fill, border, rule, ticks and markers.

comparisons.name: text-edit-dark
comparisons.description: The ruler of a TextEdit document window, full width: rule, ticks, numbers, the indent markers at 0, five left tab stops and the tail indent, Dark Aqua. Whole crop: the numbers are set in the fallback font.

comparisons.name: text-edit-drawing-dark
comparisons.description: The ruler of a TextEdit document window, full width: rule, ticks, numbers, the indent markers at 0, five left tab stops and the tail indent, Dark Aqua. The same crop with the nine numbers masked: fill, border, rule, ticks and markers.

comparisons.name: states-forced-colors-light
comparisons.description: Forced colours: the ruler keeps its rule, ticks and markers and draws them in the system's text colour on the system's background. The colours are the browser's emulated system colours, not Catalina's.

comparisons.name: focus-light
comparisons.description: Keyboard focus on the draggable tab stop, reached with Tab: a focus ring around the marker's box, Aqua. AppKit's markers cannot be focused; the ring is this library's.
